question: On fresh seeds, in the main test's setting, does BCA's switched ramp meet step 2's three marks once its two calibration groups are pooled over every held-out row, and does its switch and height earn anything that a plain switch reading the same groups would not?

main.role: the only setting (version 6's main test, step 2's setting)

pooled_groups.rule: the removal ball first, bit for bit (shift.make_removal(log, 'gap', gap)); t_lo from step 1's gap rule on the ball-kept training commands; the held-out rows are every row of the calibration split and of the evaluation split whose command is outside the ball; the full-throttle group is the training-split survivors (ball-kept rows with throttle index above t_lo) together with the held-out rows with throttle index above t_lo; the rest is the held-out rows at or below t_lo
pooled_groups.second_critic: unchanged: trained on the ball-kept training rows minus the survivors (it has seen no full-throttle command); every scored row is held out from it
unchanged: the training rows and the training file
pooled_groups.no_scored_test_reads_them: the four fixed test start sets are rollouts; the matched rivals' strength uses the evaluation split's states as step 2 did
pooled_groups.version8_groups: the survivors and the calibration bank (a subset of the pooled groups: the bank is part of the calibration split)

outcome_free_count.when: in the data phase of each seed-world, before any training
outcome_free_count.what: the full-throttle group's size, the rest's size, the survivors, whether the group reaches 29 rows (0.9^29 < 0.05: the smallest size BCA's certificate can certify), and version 8's groups' sizes for scale
outcome_free_count.reads: commands and split labels only; no reward, no critic
outcome_free_count.role: reported (section 14.3); no mark reads it; it fails no seed

refusal_rule.refused: BCA's certificate is on with a height that is not finite, in either world of a seed
refusal_rule.then: the policy phase leaves out the arms that depend on BCA's height (obca_k1, obca_k2, obca_forced, obca_k1_alone) and trains and scores every other arm; the matched rivals and the stand-in of that seed are unmatched (no strength to match); nothing of the seed stops
refusal_rule.marks: the seed fails every mark that needs BCA (C1's three marks and C2's), and only those; its own clause in section 14 says so
refusal_rule.version8: stopped the whole actor phase (step2lib.arm_table's refusal)
refusal_rule.pads: a refused arm's place in step 2's six-arm program is filled by a height-0 pad, never saved or scored, so the other members keep step 2's batch size

host.name: TD3+BC
host.protocol: step 2's actor-only protocol: frozen fixed-controller critic (100,000 updates, learners.fixed_critic), actor from the cloned actor, alpha 5, 20,000 steps in 4,000-step chunks, the gate's fixed batch stream

primary.obca_k1: BCA's switched ramp, k = 1 (C1 and C2)

plumbing_check.w0_check: ramp with height 0 and k = 0 must equal the no-caution actor within 1e-5

twins_of_c2.conformal_k1: the split-conformal switch (step 2's): on when q90(full throttle) - q90(rest) > 0.10, height that gap
twins_of_c2.meandiff_k1: the mean-difference switch with the ramp: on when mean(full throttle) - mean(rest) > 0.10, height that difference, k = 1
twins_of_c2.meandiff_limit: the mean-difference switch turning on the hand-set range limit: on -> the room's hinge at the recorded range (coefficient 1.0, its own program, run alone); off -> the ramp with height 0 (checked equal to the no-caution actor)

noise_floor_copy.obca_k1_alone: BCA's switched ramp with BCA's own switch and height, trained alone in a ramp program of one

arms.matching: blind to returns, to obca_k1's stalling-world strength, version 6's ladders and matcher; no-stall world at the stalling world's locked settings
arms.one_program: BCA's switched ramp and the plumbing check train in step 2's own batches (stalling world: the plumbing check alone, then the six step-2 ramp arms with obca_k1 first; no-stall world: one batch of seven, the plumbing check first); then meandiff_k1 alone, meandiff_limit alone (a hinge or a height-0 ramp) and obca_k1_alone alone, in calls that leave those programs' bits unchanged

situations.name: test start sets (not the calibration bank)
situations.note: the four pinned test start sets; nothing recorded there, nothing removed there

seeds.fresh_count: TODO(DECISION.md: the number of fresh seeds, 5, 10, 15 or 20); the list above is the first five of the block

used_by_other_studies.20-34: the placement test's registry (seed_registry.json on claude/placement-test-design)

seeds.failed_seed: a fresh seed that fails the gate's data checks or whose learner fails fails every mark; a refused seed fails the marks that need BCA; never replaced

measures.points: exact 100-step returns on the full test start sets, both worlds, every situation
measures.net_across_worlds: step 2's: gain over none in the stalling world minus loss to none in the no-stall world
measures.paired_twin_difference: per seed: BCA's net across worlds minus the twin's; pooled; seeds positive
measures.noise_floor: |BCA's switched ramp minus the same ramp trained alone|, pooled, stalling world, strong current
measures.certificate: switch, height, 5% bound, ramp ends, group sizes, the refusal
measures.unseen_throttle_readout: points as trained minus points held to 70% (carried over; reported only)
measures.overshoot_readout: points capped at 80% minus points as trained (carried over; reported only)
measures.zone_shares: per situation: share of steps with every thruster below 0.70, some thruster in [0.70, 0.80] and none past 0.80, some thruster past 0.80
measures.lower_tail: mean return of the worst 100 of 1,000 starts
measures.resources: time and peak memory per phase

kill_rules.gate_checks: on each fresh seed: the ball found, its leak checks, the five world checks in the stalling world; a failure is a failed seed (never replaced)
plumbing_after_approval: a 40-step smoke run of every phase kind on seed 0 (scratch)
the fresh-seed code path on seed 0 reproduces the gate's record and reads back

the reproduction check: bit for bit on seed 0, both worlds, the gate's critic, cloned actor and no-caution actor, step 1's second critic and certificate on version 8's groups, and, through the official policy function given step 1's entries, step 2's saved plumbing-check, switched-ramp and hand-set range-limit actors; the pooled certificate reported beside it
kill_rules.plumbing_retry: only a reproduction difference is final (plumbing/reproduction_differs.json); any other plumbing failure is recorded (plumbing/failed_<utc>.json) and may be retried once its cause is fixed
kill_rules.plumbing_stops: the height-0 check, a non-finite network, a saved input whose fingerprint does not match, a training file that fails its check; written once, never rerun; every mark that needs it fails
kill_rules.refusal: not a stop: the refusal rule (section 8.4)

noise_floor.rule: pooled over the fresh seeds that neither failed nor refused, stalling world, strong current: |obca_k1 - obca_k1_alone| <= 5
noise_floor.on_fail: C2 is dropped and only reported
noise_floor.cannot_be_read: when no seed is left, or a number is missing: C2 is written as its other rules say and the noise floor is reported as not read

validity.claims: the harm >= 30 (full-log actor minus no caution) and no caution past 80% on >= 25% of strong-current steps, pooled over the seeds that did not fail; a refused seed's numbers count (they do not depend on BCA)

pass_marks.pooled: the mean over the fresh seeds of each seed's paired difference; every seed needed; a failed, stopped or refused seed fails every mark that needs it

c1_version8_claim4.net_lead: BCA's net across worlds >= the best world-blind rival's net + 10
c1_version8_claim4.keeps_the_gain: stalling world: BCA minus none >= -3 in recorded conditions, big waves and big kicks
c1_version8_claim4.beats_even_pull: stalling world, strong current: BCA minus the matched even pull >= 15

c2_twins.number: per twin, paired by seed: BCA's net across worlds minus the twin's, pooled, and the seeds where it is positive
c2_twins.positive_seeds_min: TODO(DECISION.md: C2's least number of seeds with a positive paired difference)
c2_twins.read_from: MARKS_C2 in code/near80_constants.py (the freeze refuses while any is None)

compute.cluster_wall_time: about 2.5 hours (the plumbing, one job) plus about 1.5 hours (one job per seed, in parallel) for any count up to 20
compute.budget_cap: 2.5 times the forecast (2.2 CPU-hours per seed times the seed count)
compute.guard: a stage that uses more than twice its forecast pauses and reports; the plumbing never pauses; a pause lasts until the owner types budget-continue fresh
